notes: three branches meet at شعبة: the text writes شعبة and then «قال سمعت قتادة، يحدث عن أنس» after the last ح, so the tail is shared (rule 3); «أبي» (Ubayd Allah's father) is a relation with no name here
the glosses «- يعني ابن الحارث -» and «- واللفظ لهما -» are left out (rule 1)
the saying opens «أنعليه وسلم قالوا للنبي» with the Prophet's name cut off in the stored text; the link is still Anas

fixes.reason: the Prophet's name and blessing are run together as «أنعليه وسلم», so the saying's opening is unreadable as stored
